IS 1216 : 2026 Tar and Bituminous Materials - Methods of Test - Determination of Solubility in Trichloroethylene or Toluene
ICS 75.140
ICS 75.140
PCD 06
PCD 06
1 SCOPE
This standard prescribes the test method for determining the solubility of asphaltic bitumen and native asphalts in trichloroethylene or toluene.
2 REFERENCES
The standards given below contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All the standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of these standards:
